provenance.title: A Tannakian description of the local Kaletha gerbe
provenance.authors: ALEXANDER BERTOLONI MELI AND PETER DILLERY

candidates.statement: The image of the refined correspondence map should be contained in the set of pairs $(\phi, \rho)$ such that $\rho \in \mathop{\mathrm{Irr}}(\pi_0(S_{\phi}/Z(\widehat{G})^{\Gamma_F}))$.

Vogan ([@VoganLLC]) proposed that in order to upgrade the correspondence to contain $\mathop{\mathrm{Irr}}(\pi_0(S_{\phi})) \subset \mathop{\mathrm{Irr}}(S_{\phi})$ in its image, one should enlarge the domain by adding in irreducible representations of inner forms of $G$.
For a nice discussion of this topic, we recommend the survey article [@KalSurvey].

Our fixed representation $\rho$ gives an $\mathfrak{f}_{E}$-semilinear automorphism $\Phi := \rho((1_{\sigma}), \mathfrak{f}_{E})$ of $V$, which is such that $\Phi^{s}$ acts by $\rho((\sigma(\varpi_{E})), 1)$; note also that $\rho \colon \prod_{\Gamma_{E/F}} \mathbb{G}_{m}(E_{s}) \to \mathrm{GL}_{V}$ must be an algebraic homomorphism.
Note that each subspace $V_{(h_{\sigma})}$ is $\Phi$-stable, and also that $\Phi^{s}$ must act on $V_{(h_{\sigma})}$ by the scalar $\prod_{\Gamma_{E/F}} \sigma(\varpi_{E})^{h_{\sigma}}$.

Explicitly, if $\sigma_i = \mathfrak{f}_{E}^{n_i} s_E(\gamma_i)$, then we must show that $$(\Phi^{n_1} \circ f^{-1}_{\gamma_1}) \circ (\Phi^{n_2} \circ f^{-1}_{\gamma_2}) = \Phi^{n_1+n_2 + c_E(\gamma_1,\gamma_2)}f^{-1}_{\gamma_1\gamma_2}.$$ By construction, we have $$f^{-1}_{\gamma_1\gamma_2} = f^{-1}_{\gamma_1} \circ f^{-1}_{\gamma_2} \circ \Phi^{-c_E(\gamma_1,\gamma_2)},$$ which implies the desired equality.

Then we have $$\tilde{\Phi}(s_E(\gamma))(V_{(a_{\sigma}/s)_{\sigma}}) = f^{-1}_{\gamma}(V_{(a_{\sigma}/s)_{\sigma}}\otimes 1)=f^{-1}_{\gamma}(\beta_{\gamma}(V)_{(a_{\gamma^{-1}\sigma}/s)_{\sigma}})=V_{(a_{\gamma^{-1}\sigma}/s)_{\sigma}}.$$ Finally, $T$ is a functor because morphisms of $\mathcal{W}_{E/F,s}$ must necessarily commute with the $\Phi$ and $f_{\gamma}$ maps.
